page.layout: One page of text in one column, with a German passage in black letter set full width at the foot. No marginal notes. Running head centred at top, page number at top left.

main_text.p: commendabat nobis,qui iustitiæ imaginem expressurā[?] feminibus[?] oculorum ut acrioribus, ita etiam rectis & immotis pingere studuerit: quo nimirum significaret, magistratum nullius gratiam præferre debere iustis legibus, sed in improbos severum & inexorabilem, in probos mitem & mansuetum esse oportere. Hac enim via, inquit, dum ingrederentur maiores olim nostri, adversus multas simul aut motas aut suspectas immutationes rerum, se & civitatem hanc suam munierunt servaruntque.

Ceterum ne ad formandos optimos cuique mores recta desint studia, utque non tam privatam quam publicam patriæ quoque salutem tueri contendant cives, ac subinde novam semper patriæ gloriam comparare studeant: ad ea duntaxat adjiciendus est animus studia, quæ bonorum omnium consensu ad virtutem sunt accommodatissima: Quo in ordine vel primas obtinet historia, ex qua tanquam oraculo civilia petenda censemus institu-ta. [illegible, ~10 letters] : Nemo bonus fidem & sedulitatem avunculi vestri Bilibaldi Pirckheymeri, viri incomparabilis & rectissimi iudicii, iure improbare poterit: quando in hoc unum respexit, ut labore suo prodesset multis, ut ad virtutes, animi ornamenta, invitaret quam plurimos. Hæc delectatio illius, hoc gaudiu, hoc desideriu fuit, &c.

p.bl: Das lautet vngefehr inn angeregter vnser Mut-tersprach/wie folget: Glaubt mir Darumb/so hoch ist ein jedweder im Regiment zu halten / als wol er sich mit vernunfft vnd Tugend erweiset. Vnd Der jenige / so andern zum Regenten fürgesetzet/ wird zu gleich allen Bürgern mit anderst als ein gemein Spectakel vnnd Schaubild dargestellet: dessen Gebott niemand leichtlichen gehorsamen wird/ wo er nicht dieselbige Hoheit / zu deren er also erhaben / mit seinen eignen Tugenden etli-cher massen noch mehr zu orniren sich befleissiget. Wil em Obrigkeit gehorsame Bürger vñ Vnter-thanen

page.notes: Greek name at the start of the Latin passage (before the colon) is not legible at this scan; left as illegible. "feminibus" is uncertain (first letter may be f or long s); marked [?]. "expressurā" final letter uncertain; marked [?]. "Wil em" in the black-letter line: the first word is uncertain. The black-letter block is marked with bl because it is German inside a Latin page. The German last line is underlined on the scan (underline not transcribed). The "ʒ" in "zu" is transcribed as z. Printed "adjiciendus", "gaudiu", "desideriu", "orniren" are left as printed. A stray printer's mark at the top right and a dot in the left margin are not text and are omitted.
